title: Parsedmarc: pyasn1 has quadratic-time denial of service in constructed string and indefinite-length ANY decoding…
description: pyasn1 versions 0.6.4 and earlier contain a denial-of-service vulnerability due to quadratic-time complexity in decoding constructed OCTET STRINGs, constructed character strings, and indefinite-length ANY types. This occurs because the decoder repeatedly copies accumulated fragments, causing CPU exhaustion when processing attacker-controlled ASN.1 inputs with many fragments. The issue affects BER and CER decoding paths and certain non-conforming DER inputs. No confidentiality or integrity impact is reported. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 7.5 (high severity).
